major_corrections.rule: A local rewrite used inside a context must be pointwise equivalent on the exposed interface, or be a separately proved conservative extension with an explicit projection theorem. Whole-formula equisatisfiability alone is insufficient for arbitrary contextual replacement.

The theorem core requires exact decision preservation and polynomial execution. SAT witnesses can be recovered afterwards by polynomial self-reduction if a polynomial SAT decider exists. Witness pullback remains a proof-carrying enhancement, not a mandatory completeness gate.

It is sufficient to prove closure for states reachable under one fixed deterministic schedule and its fixed pivot policy. No theorem requires operational congruence for transformations the algorithm never executes.
Completeness and normalization closure are required only on Reach_A(phi), the states generated by the fixed algorithm from valid CNF inputs.

Opaque EXISTS nodes or arbitrary circuit/DAG nodes may keep encoding polynomial while merely hiding SAT hardness. Every admitted representation class must support the scheduled elimination operation and terminal decision in polynomial time; unresolved semantic choices may not be hidden as representation metadata.

Separate semantic variables from representation-node identifiers. Prefer definitional DAG nodes that are not free Boolean choices. If fresh semantic extension variables are introduced, count them in rank, size, elimination work and witness/refutation semantics.

NORMALIZE needs its own polynomial micro-step bound. Freeze an acyclic defect-dependency graph or a fixed-dimensional well-founded micro-rank; no rewrite cycle may be hidden beneath one macro elimination.

Any pre-core lane used by the theorem-mode solver must itself have a fixed polynomial worst-case bound. Unbounded-width extensionalization, subset/partition search, or expensive algebra discovery must be skipped or budget-failed before superpolynomial work.

The theorem candidate must freeze a finite program/grammar before seeing the input. TOCH, TOPA, Shaitan Lantern and AI may synthesize the next research version, but cannot add constructors during a claimed fixed polynomial run unless that meta-synthesis itself is separately formalized and polynomially bounded.

formal_state_semantics.state: S=(semantic_variables, clauses, factor_DAG, obligations, admitted_algebra_nodes, metadata)
formal_state_semantics.denotation: [[S]] is a Boolean relation over remaining semantic variables

revised_core_target.name: SCHEDULE_RELATIVE_REACHABLE_EXISTENTIAL_NORMAL_FORM_CLOSURE
revised_core_target.statement: For every CNF phi, let S0 be its canonical initial state and let xi be chosen only by the frozen syntactic pivot policy. For every reachable Si produced by the fixed algorithm, Normalize(Exists(xi,Si)) must terminate in polynomial work, produce a polynomial-size exactly decision-preserving next state Si+1, and remain inside the tractable representation language. After polynomially many scheduled eliminations, terminal truth must be polynomially decidable.

micro_normalization_requirement.rule: Every normalization rewrite must move the rewritten defect to a strictly lower frozen defect level, or decrease a fixed-dimensional polynomially bounded micro-rank.
micro_normalization_requirement.purpose: Prevent infinite or superpolynomial rewrite activity hidden inside one existential macro-step.
